newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm but rise seen capped.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm but rise seen capped.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures edged to a firm finish on Friday, raising hopes of further gains in the near term but dealers said the market would continue to struggle with a stubborn technical barrier in the absence of good news.
The lead Nikkei 225 September contract added 85 points to end at 20,415, 25 points below its day high. But volume was light at 9,290 lots.
"It looks like there are a lot of buyers on the low end," a trader at a local institution said.
He said the close above 20,400, representing the September Nikkei's third firm close on a weekly basis, boded well for further gains.
But dealers said the market would face strong profit-taking pressure above 20,500 against a backdrop of continuing financial sector scandals.
Taiwan stock index futures ended on an upbeat note, boosted by a 176.49 points rise on Taiwan's weighted index, which closed at 9,808.91.
Taipei stocks rose on heavy gains in the electronics sector and bullish technicals, dealers said.
The July MSCI Taiwan index contract added 11.7 to 427.5 on volume of 2,128 lots.
